integrity: The proof uses the published exact low-dimensional cases, quadratic-diagonal degree, boundary case, and sufficient binomial criterion, then supplies a separate dimension argument for the sole remaining higher-dimensional pair. The packaged verifier checks the arithmetic identities and inequalities only; the geometric proof is explicit in RESULT.md.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the generic incidence degree and birationality range, not the degree or singularities of the incidence image and not the detailed geometry of special multiple-cone strata.
title: The exact birational range for involutive-cone incidences
